Summary: God's command to Samuel: anoint Saul to be captain over Israel against the Philistines.
Commandment: Thou shalt anoint Saul to be captain over my people Israel, that he may save my people out of the hand of the Philistines.
Application: Saul was anointed privately (1 Samuel 10:1) and then chosen publicly by lot (10:20-24). This row covers the command to anoint, not Saul's later reign or his Amalek disobedience (that command is the held Remember Amalek item, not duplicated here).
Purpose: To give Israel the king they demanded as a captain to save them from the Philistines, while God heard their cry (1 Samuel 9:16).
